dialogues.speaker: Irqichaykuna Nui
dialogues.text: An easy-breezy Natlan in an easy-breezy summer! Hey there, folks! Anyone who paints the market's statue in different colors will receive a generous reward!

dialogues.speaker: Irqichaykuna Nui
dialogues.text: And you! You look like somebody who can walk away with the grand prize!
